stats_texts.title: Global Benchmark Statistics
stats_texts.explain_stats_list_1:
Basis: {{count}} data points | As of: {{lastUpdate}}

* **Mean ({{mean}}):** The arithmetic average of all results.
* **p90 ({{p90}}):** Top 10%. Only 1 in 10 websites scores {{p90}} or higher.
* **p75 ({{p75}}):** Above average. 25% of websites score {{p75}} or higher.
* **p50 ({{p50}}):** Median. 50% of websites score {{p50}} or higher.
* **p25 ({{p25}}):** Below average. 75% of websites score {{p25}} or higher.
* **p10 ({{p10}}):** Bottom 10%. 90% of websites score {{p10}} or higher.
